description:
Frontend Developer  

 

 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  

 

 
 
 Develop and maintain responsive, scalable, and user-friendly web applications. 

 
 

 
 
 Build reusable UI components using modern front-end technologies. 

 
 

 
 
 Translate UI/UX designs and business requirements into functional web applications. 

 
 

 
 
 Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and backend services. 

 
 

 
 
 Optimize applications for performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility. 

 
 

 
 
 Troubleshoot and resolve application issues. 

 
 

 
 
 Participate in code reviews, testing, and Agile development activities. 

 
 

 
 
 Collaborate with designers, backend developers, QA, and product teams. 

 
 

 
 REQUIRED SKILLS  

 

 
 
 Hands-on experience with Angular, JavaScript, and TypeScript . 

 
 

 
 
 Proficiency in HTML5 and CSS3 . 

 
 

 
 
 Experience with NGRX/Redux or similar state management frameworks. 

 
 

 
 
 Understanding of responsive web design and front-end architecture. 

 
 

 
 
 Experience with REST API integration . 

 
 

 
 
 Good knowledge of debugging, testing, and performance optimization. 

 
 

 
 
 Strong problem-solving and communication skills. 

 
 



 
 
 QUALIFICATIONS  

 

 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering , or a related field. 

 
 

 
 
 3+ years of experience in front-end development. 

 
 

 
 
 Experience building responsive and enterprise-grade web applications. 

 
 

 
 
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 

 
 

 
 
 Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. 

 
 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 40,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 142,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post
